card.name: Digits inside dense number tables
card.fires_on: The leading digit of a number (often 0 or 1) just before a decimal point, inside tables of many numbers such as dosimetry, nutrition or infusion rates. Also fires on 'Effect' in a table-style header.

modes.label: Digit in number tables
modes.description: A first digit before a decimal point in a run of table values.

modes.label: Table header word
modes.description: The word Effect in a column heading in an interaction table.
modes.example: Mechanism and Clinical<< Effect>>(s) JUVMO is an inhibitor

card.writes: The promoted tokens are code-like fragments, so there is no clear output effect on medical text.
card.plain: It lights up on digits in crowded tables of numbers, such as dosing or radiation tables.
